thread:
maria_support: FYI — ACME (customer) opened a high-priority ticket complaining that after yesterday's rollout the assistant behaviour changed. They say answers now often start with "Note:" and are shorter / omit bullet details. They gave a before/after and a minimal repro. Escalating to eng/ML.

alex_eng: Thanks. Can you paste the customer's minimal repro and the exact request they sent? Also which model + endpoint?

maria_support: Pasting below (redacted). They call our chat endpoint with the same payload, different responses pre/post rollout. Model: rwd-open-1. Endpoint: /v1/chat/completions.

Customer original (before rollout):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "rwd-open-1",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant. Be thorough and include examples."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "How do I parse CSV in Python?"}
  ],
  "max_tokens": 300
}
```

Response (before):
"Use the built-in csv module...
Examples:
- reader: ...
- DictReader: ..."

Customer now (after rollout) with identical request:
Response (after):
"Note: I can't provide that."

maria_support: They included request ids: req-7891 pre, req-8153 post. They said they haven't changed input. They did try pinning older model version and got original behaviour.

sri_ml: Interesting — two likely suspects: 1) chat template/system message wrapping changed (we rolled a tweak that injects soft delimiters around system content), 2) tokenizer change where delimiter tokens merged with system text producing different effective prompt. Can you dump the exact system string we sent and the tokenization for both versions?

maria_support: I pulled the logs. Before rollout the system string was exactly: "You are a helpful assistant. Be thorough and include examples." After rollout we injected delimiters for safety: "<SYS> You are a helpful assistant. Be thorough and include examples. </SYS>".

alex_eng: That matches the deploy notes — we added a small change to surround system messages with explicit markers to help downstream parsers. Did we also update tokenizer mapping or tokenization config?

sri_ml: Yes — the tokenizer release included a trimming/merge fix that changes how angle brackets are tokenized for some encodings. I ran a quick check with the old vs new tokenizer on that system string.

sri_ml: Repro code (toy):
```
# using internal tokenizer shim
old_tokens = tokenizer_v1.encode("You are a helpful assistant. Be thorough and include examples.")
new_tokens = tokenizer_v2.encode("<SYS> You are a helpful assistant. Be thorough and include examples. </SYS>")
print(len(old_tokens), old_tokens[:8])
print(len(new_tokens), new_tokens[:12])
```

sri_ml: Result: old produced 14 tokens; new produced 9 tokens but the first few tokens corresponded to a single merged token that included the '<SYS>' + next word. That shifted all subsequent token positions, which in turn changed our prompt truncation logic when max_tokens/window slicing happens. In some cases the effective system content was truncated and the safety heuristics fired, producing a short "Note: I can't provide that." reply.

ben_pm: Oof. So two simultaneous changes (delimiters + tokenizer tweak) cause a positional shift bug in prompt windowing. Did we enable this change cluster-wide or only in Canary? What's rollout state?

deploy-bot: Deployment rwd-safety-templates v2 rolled to 100% at 2026-03-14T02:15Z. Tokenizer-v2 was enabled globally at 2026-03-14T02:00Z.

alex_eng: Confirmed. Full rollout happened. We need a mitigation: either revert the delimiter injection config or temporarily roll tokenizer back and patch windowing code. Quickest path?

sri_ml: Fastest mitigation is config toggle to stop injecting <SYS> markers — that will restore token alignment for now. I'll prepare a patch for the tokenization logic to avoid merged-token positional drift long-term.

maria_support: Customer wants an ETA. Can we offer a rollback ETA? They are in prod and have high traffic.

alex_eng: I can flip the config at infra level within 30 min and run a canary. I'll coordinate with infra to push a toggle that removes the markers at request-time. I will post the canary logs here.

sri_ml: Meanwhile, to help customers self-diagnose we should provide a repro checklist:
1) Show the exact request body + model + request-id.
2) Ask them to run tokenization locally and report token counts for the system message. We can provide small snippet:
```
# curl-able example
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tokenize \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-open-1","text":"<SYS> You are a helpful assistant... </SYS>"}'
```
3) If token counts differ significantly vs their expectation, ask them to try pinning model to pre-release digest (we can give pinned version).

maria_support: I'll send that checklist to ACME and ask for token dumps and request-ids. Also I'll tell them we're doing a rapid config rollback.

alex_eng: Canary toggle applied at 1769124000. Canary logs: replaced markers=false on 10% of traffic, no errors. After 20 min I pushed to 100% at 1769124200. Verified sample request (req-8153 replayed) now returns original long-form answer for the customer example.

maria_support: Great — I told ACME we reverted the template markers and they confirmed behavior restored on their side. They asked for postmortem and precise remediation timeline.

sri_ml: I'll own the follow-up patch: adjust tokenizer merging rules and update prompt-windowing logic so that positional indices are robust to token merges. Plan: patch branch -> internal eval -> canary -> release. ETA 3 days.

ben_pm: Please add a postmortem doc with timeline, root cause (two independent changes interacting), customer impact, rollback steps, and mitigation. Also add test coverage to ensure tokenization changes don't shift prompt windows unexpectedly.

maria_support: Will draft postmortem and send to ops and legal for customer comms. ACME is satisfied for now. Closing ticket once PM/ML have remediation plan and doc. :thumbsup:

alex_eng: Thanks all. Followups: sri_ml to open PR; ben_pm to own postmortem; maria_support to confirm closure with ACME.

deploy-bot: Incident record created: IR-2026-0314-01 -> "Prompt window misalignment after template + tokenizer changes"

maria_support: Marking this thread resolved (for support) — will re-open if ACME reports regressions.
